newsitem.title: USA: Sigma-Tau sues General Nutrition over patent.
newsitem.headline: Sigma-Tau sues General Nutrition over patent.

text.p: Sigma-Tau Industrie Farmaceutiche Riunute SpA of Italy sued General Nutrition Corp in a dispute over a patented formula used in cardiac and vascular therapy, according to court documents.

In papers released Monday by the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Rome-based Sigma-Tau alleges that General Nutrition sells products containing the nutrient L-carnitine and the cell-death inhibitor coenzyme Q-10 in compositions that infringe Sigma-Tau's patent 232 for the "pharmaceutical composition with metabolic and energetic activity."
Sigma-Tau is seeking a court order blocking further alleged infringement and unspecified damages tripled for "wilful infringement."
No one could be reached for comment at the General Nutrition offices in Pittsburgh.
